Name: Crop Variation (Updated)
Author: 0Logophile0
Description:
[size=4]Originally authored by Aedenthorn and updated for 1.6

[color=#f1f1f1]This mod randomly changes the displayed size and color of all crops based values set in the configuration.[/color]

By default, size and colour both affect quality of crops, up to one level of quality +/- each, meaning bigger, brighter crops have increased quality and smaller, darker crops have decreased quality.

[/size][u][size=4]INSTALLATION[/size][/u]
[list]
[*][size=3]Download[/size]
[*][size=3]Extract/unzip[/size]
[*][size=3]Place in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder[/size]
[/list]
[u][size=4]CONFIGURATION[/size][/u]
[list]
[*][size=3]Can be configured from the in-game menu if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿ is installed.[/size]
[*][size=3]Can be configured via editing the config.json in the file[/size]
[/list][size=3]
Source code can be found on my fork of Aedenthorn's SDV repo [/size][url=https://github.com/Rogue-Toast/AedenthornSDVMods][size=3]here[/size][/url][size=3]﻿.[/size]


[size=3][u]CREDITS[/u]
Thanks to Aedenthorn for making this mod in the first place and for providing open permissions so modders could make updates for 1.6
Special thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/RaffieJohn/about-me]RaffieJohn[/url]﻿ for testing and providing the screenshots! 🌺[/size]
